text:
alex_k: Heads-up — planning a phased cutover for schema change on orders tomorrow 03:30 UTC. This is a slow backfill (non-blocking writes) + dual-write window. Need a primary deploy owner, backup, and someone to run smoke checks.
maya_g: Can you share a rough duration estimate and whether dual-write is mandatory? There's infra maintenance at 03:00 that might overlap.
alex_k: Estimate: dual-write on for ~60m, backfill runs concurrently, expecting ~45m to finish but we’ll keep a 90m safety window. Dual-write is required for one hour to ensure no missing writes while we validate read path.
Sample quick checks (run before cutover):
```sql
-- ensure there are no huge tails
SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE migrated = false AND created_at < now() - interval '7 days';
```
If that returns > 10k we slow down the backfill.
samir_s: I can be rollback owner. If we need to revert schema toggles I’ll apply the rollback flag and cut traffic back. What’s the smoke checklist look like? :thumbsup:
julia_p: I’ll be primary deploy owner for the cutover. Samir is backup, confirmed.
qa_lead: Smoke checklist (short):
- confirm dual-write feature flag toggles (console + db) :white_check_mark:
- run healthcheck against orders-api (endpoint /health) and verify 200
- run sample read path against new column set: `curl -sS https://staging.api/orders/123 | jq` and validate fields
- validate tail of backfill: `SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE migrated = false;` before and after
- spot-check metrics: errors, 5xx, latency on per-route dashboard
Quick commands for deploy (to paste in deploy runbook):
```bash
kubectl set image deploy/orders-api orders-api=registry/redwood/orders:v3.2.1
pg_ctl -D /var/lib/postgres reload # apply new role mappings
```
alex_k: Rollback plan summary: flip feature flag off -> switch reads back to old column map -> run small compatibility migration if needed -> notify stakeholders. Keep backups and a restore checklist ready.
maya_g: That infra maintenance at 03:00 will be a short networking patch (expected 10m). Can we nudge the window to 03:30 to avoid overlap? My team prefers avoiding simultaneous changes.
julia_p: 03:30 works for me. I'll update the runbook times and shift preflight to 03:05 UTC.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: deployment window for orders schema migration set for 2098768830 (2030-11-?? 03:30:30 UTC). Notifying on-call and posting runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orders-schema-cutover
alex_k: Thanks all — Julia primary, Samir backup, QA lead on verifications. Post-deploy please paste short status in this thread (ok / degraded / rollback). I'll start final preflight 03:05 UTC.
